Love the BBQ Pork Bánh Mì
Aug 2026 • Friends
You know it's good when you see the queue, with a mix of locals and tourists standing in line. And queuing is part of the process, including not getting knocked down by scooters zipping out of the alleyway. The Mi Bánh Mì Thịt Nướng (with BBQ pork) was the most flavourful and well worth the wait. It's the Central Vietnam variant of the ubiquitous and more well-known Bánh Mì with ham filling, and I very much prefer it with BBQ pork. They also offer other types of Bánh Mì: Mixed, Vegetarian, Pork & Ham, Chicken, Fried Eggs.

The place has lost its quality and charm
Aug 2026 • Solo
It’s truly a shame what overtourism and social media have done to this once special Bahn mi stand. I used to live in Hoi An and had breakfast here almost every day. I would chat with the owner and the ladies would make my bánh mì to my specifications with extra pâté and extra egg sauce. It was perfection. Today, I took a seat in the dining room and ordered my sandwich the same way. I watched as the server simply pulled one of the many dozens of PREMADE Banh mi out of the toasting oven and served it to me, even after acknowledging and agreeing to my special requests. Because it was sitting in the oven for who knows how long, the bread was dried out and not fluffy inside and the pate was also dried out. It simply lacked the freshness that was the hallmark of the place. I have had much better banh mi’s elsewhere in Vietnam. The place has lost its charm and quality that once made it stand out. Overrun by pushy tourists, it was frantic, chaotic and off putting. How very sad.
